name: Ona Ken! 1.2
source:
This is the sequel to Ona Ken
Hibiki returns after an absence of few days due to fever
Nao, her childhood friend, tells her that Rika has been kidnapped. In order for Rika to be released,  Hibiki has to perform 5 exhibitionist tasks for the kidnapper. What will Hibiki do? Will she perform the tasks or refrain from doing them? Find the outcome as you play Ona Ken 1.2
translation:
这是奥纳肯的续集
响因发烧缺席几天后回归
她儿时的朋友奈绪告诉她莉卡被绑架了。为了让理香获释，响必须为绑匪执行5项暴露狂任务。响会做什么？她会执行这些任务还是不执行这些任务？在玩《Ona Ken 1.2》时寻找结果
